LanguageData.DMS_Mech_ClusterWeaver.label: cluster weaver
LanguageData.DMS_Mech_ClusterWeaver.description: United Army Systems "Sakalava", nicknamed the "Cluster Weaver", is a superheavy FPV mothership propelled by multiple rotor sets. The drone bay slung beneath its 5-meter-wingspan frame carries up to 30 suicide drones and can guide them precisely from kilometers away. It was never a decisive weapon of all-out war, but in the regional armed conflicts after the Third World War it remained a terrifying threat second only to the "Wyvern" flocks.\n\nThe Cluster Weaver uses metal-reinforced carbon fiber as its main structure and carries almost no additional armor. Even so, its high-precision radar and three precision turrets can annihilate targets before the enemy gets close enough to ambush it, leaving local militias with little hope of surviving its attacks.
